reading: Trees can help cool a city.
Their leaves give people shade on hot days.
Trees also release water into the air, and this helps cool it.
A tree near a building can reduce the need for air conditioning.
People need to choose trees that suit the local climate.
Young trees need care after people plant them.

vocabulary.definition: a place where something blocks direct sunlight
to make something smaller or less
the usual weather in a place over many years

entries.ja: 日光が直接当たらない場所。
entries.zh-Hans: 某物阻挡阳光直射的地方。
entries.es: Un lugar donde algo bloquea la luz solar directa.
entries.pt-BR: Um lugar onde algo bloqueia a luz solar direta.

entries.ja: 何かの大きさを小さくしたり、量を減らしたりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 더 작게 만들거나 양을 줄이다.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某物变得更小或更少。
entries.es: Hacer algo más pequeño o en menor cantidad.
entries.pt-BR: Tornar algo menor ou em menor quantidade.

entries.ja: ある場所での何年にもわたる通常の天気。
entries.ko: 한 장소에서 여러 해 동안의 일반적인 날씨.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个地方多年来的常规天气。
entries.es: El tiempo habitual en un lugar durante muchos años.
entries.pt-BR: O tempo habitual de um lugar ao longo de muitos anos.
